lines.en: I scrape along the wet mud.

lines.zh: 我的囊体一鼓一缩地走。
lines.en: My sac swells and shrinks as I move.

lines.zh: 水里走比岸上舒服得多。
lines.en: Moving in water is far easier than on land.
I crawl slowly over the reef.

lines.zh: 每一步都黏在湿润的土上。
lines.en: Each step sticks to the damp soil.
I drag my sac along; it's heavy.

lines.zh: 我从浅水挪到更浅的地方。
lines.en: I shift from shallow water to shallower still.
I crawl toward anything living.
This pool is enough to carry me across.
I follow the damp trail.

lines.zh: 我挪动身体，泥都被搅起。
lines.en: As I move, the mud churns up.
I can walk on land too, only slowly.
I shift over inch by inch.

lines.zh: 我拖着沉甸甸的囊，爬上湿沙。
lines.en: I haul my heavy sac up onto the wet sand.
I walk toward the scent.

lines.zh: 潮湿的地方，就是我的路。
lines.en: Where it's damp, that's my road.

lines.zh: 我把囊收起来，静静待着。
lines.en: I draw my sac in and rest.

lines.zh: 我半沉在水里，只露出一点。
lines.en: I sink half in water, barely showing.
My body pulses gently.

lines.zh: 我等着，等潮水带来什么。
lines.en: I wait for the tide to bring something.
These waters are my hunting ground.
I open and close slowly, as if breathing.
The living things around have gone quiet.
I keep still and the mud settles.
My color matches the seafloor.
I listen to pulses under the water.
This is a good place to grow myself.
I stay perfectly still, waiting for someone.

lines.zh: 海嗣不需要休息，可我喜欢停。
lines.en: Seaborn need no rest, but I like to stop.

lines.zh: 我在等食物自己走上来。
lines.en: I wait for food to walk up to me.

lines.zh: 我朝你的方向搏动了一下。
lines.en: I pulse once in your direction.
Something living; I smell it.
There is much water in you.
I slowly raise myself to look at you.
You move; that's enough.
I won't approach yet; I'll watch first.
My sac is swollen full.

lines.zh: 你站在岸边，我的囊已经鼓满。
lines.en: You stand on the bank and my sac is already full.

lines.zh: 这片海，现在到处都是我们。
lines.en: The seaborn are everywhere in this sea now.
I've memorized your shape.
My sac has been punctured.
Soft things feel pain too.

lines.zh: 受击之后，我会缩起来再张。
lines.en: Struck, I curl up, then spread again.

lines.zh: 我流出的东西是透明的。
lines.en: What seeps from me is clear.
Cells churn inside me.
The mud clings to me tighter.
My pulse has gone irregular.
I slowly retract.
This wound will regrow fast.
Don't step on my sac.
That smell is like the sap of something alive.

lines.zh: 我朝味道的方向挪过去。
lines.en: I shift toward the smell.
I can swallow this.
My sac is beginning to swell.
Give it; I need the nourishment.
I come slowly; I won't frighten you.

lines.zh: 这股湿润的味道让我兴奋。
lines.en: This damp smell excites me.

lines.zh: 你手放下，让它掉进水里。
lines.en: Lower your hand and let it drop into the water.
I'll follow until I have it.
This bite can make me grow.
I bump into it and slide away.

lines.zh: 我贴着你腿滑过，留下一层黏液。
lines.en: I slide past your leg and leave a film of slime.
Don't step on me; I'll cling.
I slide past your feet.
In mud, a bump makes no sound.

lines.zh: 我一侧身，就贴着墙过去。
lines.en: I turn sideways and slip along the wall.
Wet things are hard to push away.

lines.zh: 我的囊被压了一下，很不舒服。
lines.en: My sac got squeezed; it's unpleasant.

lines.zh: 你踩进我游的这片水了。
lines.en: You stepped into the water I swim.
I pressed against you by accident.
Another sac draws near.
We touch sac walls.

lines.zh: 水里的养分够养我们俩。
lines.en: There's enough in the water for both.
We drift together with the current.

lines.zh: 它的搏动和我的合上了。
lines.en: Its pulse falls in with mine.
At a time like this, I don't feed.
We cling side by side to the stone.
Two trails remain in the wet mud.

lines.zh: 这一片海底，会更多我们。
lines.en: This seabed will hold more of us.

lines.zh: 我们的囊贴着，搏动慢慢对齐。
lines.en: Our sacs press together and our pulses slowly align.
I draw it into my sac.
This has nourishment; I'll take it.
I wrap it in my soft body.
Things in water can all be eaten.
I drag it back to the shallows.
I test the taste.
It's a bit hard; it will dissolve.
I keep it by my sac.
This is not enough to grow on.
I curl it up and carry it off.
That is something alive.
My sac swells toward it.
I mean to have it.

lines.zh: 我的囊壁绷紧，认准了那个方向。
lines.en: My sac wall tightens toward that direction.
The target isn't far from the water.
I slowly gather my body.
The scent is strongest this way.
I can't let it get far.
I begin the chase.

lines.zh: 猎物就在那边的浅水里。
lines.en: The prey is in the shallows over there.
I crawl low toward it.
It runs; I follow slowly.
The distance shortens bit by bit.
I trace the water trail.
The ground it crossed is wet.
No rush; I outlast it.
I extend threads to feel the way.
It cannot hide.
I work around behind it.
A little closer and it's done.
I press my sac over it and wrap it up.
My threads burrow in and feed.
It struggles, but I am stickier.
I drag it into the water.
I swallow most of it in one gulp.
My soft body smothers it.
My pulse suddenly quickens.
I coil around its limbs.
It has melted into juice.
I tighten slowly and don't let go.

lines.zh: 我从海边的浅滩爬上来。
lines.en: I crawl up from the coastal shallows.
The water withdrew and I'm exposed.
The Matrocellular Nurse comes ashore.

lines.zh: 我搏动着，湿了一整片地。
lines.en: I pulse and wet the whole patch.

lines.zh: 这片陆地，我们迟早占下。
lines.en: We will take this land in time.
I rise out of the mud.
The seaborn have already reached here.
My sac is not yet full.
I slowly unfold my body.
The water here tastes new.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的湿皮，冒出白气。
lines.en: Fire roasts my wet skin and white steam rises.
I hit the ground and spread out flat.

lines.zh: 水太多，我反而吸不到气。
lines.en: Too much water, and I can't draw anything in.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的囊掀得歪了。
lines.en: The blast wrenches my sac askew.
An arrow passes through my soft body.

lines.zh: 怪异的力钻进我体内，搏动全乱了。
lines.en: Strange force enters me and my pulse scrambles.
Starved long enough, my sac shrivels.

lines.zh: 雷打在水面上，我整片都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the water and I go numb all over.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有水，我在干裂。
lines.en: No water in the void; I'm drying out.
